paragraphs.en: # YOLO curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/v2/install | bash # Package managers npm i -g @opencode/cli@latest # or bun/pnpm/yarn brew install anomalyco/tap/opencode-v2 # macOS and Linux (recommended, always up to date) brew install opencode # macOS and Linux (official brew formula, updated less) sudo pacman -S opencode # Arch Linux (Stable) paru -S opencode-beta # Arch Linux (Latest from AUR) mise use -g opencode # Any OS nix run github:anomalyco/opencode # Nix Tip
paragraphs.zh: # YOLO（直接安装） curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/v2/install | bash # 包管理器 npm i -g @opencode/cli@latest # 或 bun/pnpm/yarn brew install anomalyco/tap/opencode-v2 # macOS 和 Linux（推荐，始终最新） brew install opencode # macOS 和 Linux（官方 brew formula，更新较慢） sudo pacman -S opencode # Arch Linux（稳定版） paru -S opencode-beta # Arch Linux（AUR 最新版） mise use -g opencode # 任意操作系统 nix run github:anomalyco/opencode # Nix 提示

paragraphs.en: Remove versions older than 0.1.x before installing.
paragraphs.zh: 安装前请先移除 0.1.x 之前的旧版本。

paragraphs.en: OpenCode is also available as a desktop application. Download it from opencode.ai/download .
paragraphs.zh: OpenCode 也提供桌面应用程序版本。 你可以从 opencode.ai/download 下载它。

sents.en: OpenCode is also available as a desktop application.
sents.zh: OpenCode 也提供桌面应用程序版本。
你可以从 opencode.ai/download 下载它。

paragraphs.en: # macOS (Homebrew) brew install --cask opencode-desktop Installation Directory The install script installs OpenCode to $HOME/.opencode/bin .
paragraphs.zh: # macOS (Homebrew) brew install --cask opencode-desktop 安装目录 安装脚本会将 OpenCode 安装到 $HOME/.opencode/bin 。

paragraphs.en: OpenCode includes two built-in agents you can switch between with the Tab key.
paragraphs.zh: OpenCode 包含两个内置智能体，你可以使用 Tab 键在它们之间切换。

paragraphs.en: Also included is a general subagent for complex searches and multistep tasks. This is used internally and can be invoked using @general in messages.
paragraphs.zh: 另外还包含一个通用的智能体（subagent），用于复杂搜索和多步骤任务。 它在内部使用，可以通过在消息中使用 @general 来调用。

sents.en: Also included is a general subagent for complex searches and multistep tasks.
sents.zh: 另外还包含一个通用的智能体（subagent），用于复杂搜索和多步骤任务。

sents.en: This is used internally and can be invoked using @general in messages.
sents.zh: 它在内部使用，可以通过在消息中使用 @general 来调用。

paragraphs.en: For more info on how to configure OpenCode, head over to our docs .
paragraphs.zh: 如需了解更多关于如何配置 OpenCode 的信息，请前往我们的文档。

paragraphs.en: If you're interested in contributing to OpenCode, please read our contributing docs before submitting a pull request.
paragraphs.zh: 如果您有兴趣为 OpenCode 做出贡献，请在提交拉取请求（pull request）之前先阅读我们的贡献文档。

paragraphs.en: If you are working on a project that's related to OpenCode and is using "opencode" as part of its name, for example "opencode-dashboard" or "opencode-mobile", please add a note to your README to clarify that it is not built by the OpenCode team and is not affiliated with us in any way.
paragraphs.zh: 如果您正在开发一个与 OpenCode 相关、且名称中包含 "opencode" 的项目，例如 "opencode-dashboard" 或 "opencode-mobile"，请在您的 README 中添加说明，以澄清该项目并非由 OpenCode 团队构建，也与我们没有任何隶属关系。
